question: Q3: round 2, call D2 = G(2,7,8,13), quarter-step q3: a = a + b + y; d = ror8(d ^ a), y = m15 (a chain word) - degrees of freedom / score-optimal value (here: is the internal overflow mask needed?).
number: Score-optimal value of the one free choice at this step: the internal mask. With it the step is 9 ops; without it 8 ops (tracer, 0 mismatches vs scalar on 200 inputs), a saving of 1 op = 0.00241 bit of time_log2 (all 3 internal masks: 592 ops, 0.00724 bit). The mask only protects against a lane sum reaching 2^36. Sampled on 53477376 random inputs with the mask left out: the unreduced a-chain at this step has mean 8.808 units (independent-uniform model 8.807), variance 1.50 (model 1.33); P(sum >= 12 units) = 3.85e-03, P(>= 13) = 1.61e-04, largest seen 14.90 units; the lane limit is 16. No overflow in the sample. The independent-uniform model understates the tail (it gives 8.2e-05 at 13), so it is not used. Extrapolating by the smallest observed per-unit tail ratio (4.6): P(>= 16) <= 1.6e-06 per evaluation (an extrapolation, not a proof). An overflow corrupts that lane and its neighbour, so a point is wrong; cost about 4p of success probability, at most 6.5e-06 for this site against the 1.5e-3 margin of the filed entry.
notes: Tools first reproduced: 7-round empty-input vector af1349b9...f3262 and verifier blake3.py (rounds 1,2,3,5,7 on 40 random blocks each, 3-round 0^32||x on 100 inputs, all equal); traced circuit = 595 ops and time_log2 125.10856 (shipped), 0 mismatches vs scalar on 200 inputs. LEVER CANDIDATE, small: dropping the mask is exact except with probability p per evaluation that the unreduced sum reaches 2^36; p is bounded here only by sampling plus a ratio extrapolation. Sampling: 51 chunks of 2^20 random inputs (5.3e7), one process, under 5 min. research/blake3_r3/levers_step_count.md called this idea a GUESS that it is false and did not test it; the sampled tail stays well under 16 units (max 14.9). Not filing-ready: needs a rigorous bound (exact chain distribution or importance sampling) and a ledger line for the added failure probability. Gain counts this site only; the three sites together are 0.0072 bit.
held_fixed: same circuit except the mask at q3 of round 2 call 2.; all other masks (160 in rotations, 4 digest masks, the other two internal masks) kept
reopen_if: an importance-sampled or exact distribution of this chain puts P(sum >= 16 units) below 1e-6 (then file the saving), or above 1e-3 (then close)
